title: Binary content in the URL-safe base64 alphabet

source.note: composed: `-` and `_` belong to RFC 4648 §5, not to the standard alphabet of §4 that "JSON Base64 encoding" means. Rejected rather than accepted, because accepting both alphabets makes a payload's bytes depend on which decoder read it.

notes: Neither ECMA-430 §6.4 nor ECMA-432 §7.2 names an alphabet. A lenient implementation that accepts both would decode this to ab cd ef ff.
